newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: First Austrian nominates new chief exec.
newsitem.headline: First Austrian nominates new chief exec.

text.p: Die Erste Oesterreichische Spar-Casse Bank (First Austrian) said on Tuesday it had nominated director Andreas Treichl to replace Konrad Fuchs as chief executive.
Fuchs announced earlier this month he would step down as chief executive of Austria's third biggest bank in mid-1997 after 25 years as a board member and eight years as chief executive.

In a statement, First Austrian said the supervisory board would consider Treichl's nomination at its next meeting on March 19. Treichl is currently responsible for commercial banking, marketing, advertising and part of First Austrian's branch network. -- Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
